records.scope: Exactly one replacement asset, original size and actual 120x120 thumbnail. No shared visual QA ledger, code or spec changes.
records.target: コクワガタ（成虫・雄） / Dorcus rectus
observations: Regeneration removes the conspicuous serial large inner teeth that caused the prior strict species failure.
Jaws remain developed and relatively long; length alone is not rejected, per prior museum source noting developed jaws in larger males.
120px rendering preserves the principal tooth pair and generic stag beetle silhouette.
Visual species fidelity passes the established mandible/body criteria; this is not specimen-level taxonomic certification.

reference_basis.source_description: 茅ヶ崎市博物館研究紀要 (2025), printed p35: male Dorcus rectus has one pair of inner tooth projections.

limitations: Original image and one actual 120px rendering only.
No invented quantitative jaw length or exact tooth-position threshold.
No whole-asset collection inspected in this review.

readability_120px.observed: Paired jaws, one principal tooth per jaw, elongated beetle body and six legs remain legible. Antennae are visible but fine terminal segmentation is not resolvable at this size. Name distinction from cicada/chafer is clear.

text_or_answer_leak.observed: No lettering, labels, species name, seasonal cue, answer marker or human-readable inscription.

species_features.dominant_inner_teeth: Exactly one conspicuous inward main tooth per mandible; one paired set.
species_features.mandible_curve: Main stems are slender with gradual curve and inward tips, without the previous broad semicircular saw-tooth silhouette.
species_features.second_major_tooth_series: Absent. Tiny inner-edge details are not comparable to the main tooth and do not form a second prominent tooth series.
species_features.body: Black brown elongated body, distinct head/pronotum/paired elongated elytra.
species_features.forbidden_horns_or_head_processes: No central rhinoceros horn or large Miyama-like head crown processes.
